record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For the reversible quadratic centers ẋ = −y + xy and ẏ = x + Dx² + Fy², determine whether the maximum possible number of critical periods is 2.

evidence.quote: Problem 15. Consider the family of reversible quadratic centers { ˙x =−y +xy, ˙y =x +Dx2 +Fy 2. Is 2 its maximum number of critical periods?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the two-parameter family of planar polynomial differential systems
$$\dot x = -y + xy, \qquad \dot y = x + D x^2 + F y^2,$$
where $D, F \in \mathbb{R}$. The origin is a center for every $(D,F)$, and the system is reversible with respect to the $x$-axis. Let $P(s)$ denote the period of the periodic orbit of the center passing through the point $(s,0)$, for $s$ in the maximal open interval on which the periodic orbits are defined (i.e., the period annulus of the origin). A critical period is a value of $s$ at which $P'(s) = 0$, i.e., an isolated critical point of the period function. 

Question: Is the supremum, over all $(D,F) \in \mathbb{R}^2$, of the number of critical periods of the period function $P$ on the period annulus equal to $2$?
artifact.category_tag: period function of planar polynomial centers
artifact.status_search_result: The bifurcation of critical periods from the inner boundary of the period annulus was shown to be at most 2 by Chicone–Jacobs (1989). Recent work (Mañosas–Rojas–Villadelprat, arXiv:2203.12966, 2022) establishes that the criticality at the outer boundary (polycycle) is at most 2 for parameters outside two exceptional segments {-1}×[0,1] and {0}×[0,2], where the behavior is not yet settled. Hence the global conjecture that the maximum number of critical periods is 2 remains only partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: The criticality of reversible quadratic centers at the outer boundary of its period annulus
status_evidence.snippet: Criticality at the outer boundary is at most 2 for all parameters outside the segments {-1}×[0,1] and {0}×[0,2].
status_evidence.claim: Provides at-most-2 bound on outer-boundary criticality for the family, except on two exceptional parameter segments.
